notes:
**CHR-1257 phase 2a, Stitch chrome (2026-11-27, awaiting Christian's approval).** Dark theme of `app-shell` in the Stitch chrome: same layout, the root binds `--chrome-*` from `chrome-dark.*`. Shows the Inspect tool in `hover` with its hint tooltip (key I). The user-screen frame stays light. `chrome-dark.float` was darkened in this phase (a CHR-1257 token, used only by CHR-1257 dark screens) so the floating cards read as one surface against the dark workspace.
